exact_text: When I say number I mean ALL numbers, not just unfamiliar numbers
applied_rule: Every number is routed to secondary image inspection. Dictionary/roster membership, familiarity, plausible value, clean appearance and previous deterministic success must never suppress numeric routing.
coverage: Numeric quantities/identifiers expressed as digits, amounts, dates, years, page/bill/section numbers, ordinals and written/Roman numeric forms belong to the requirement. Detection ambiguity or unsupported forms are explicit coverage gaps requiring inspection/coverage work, not exemptions from the rule.
implementation_status: Requirement clarified; T97 remains the next READY offline integration. Current detector handles digit-bearing tokens and some Roman contexts and is not proved to detect every numeric expression.
tests_required_in_T97: Familiar1,10,660,1866,703and2794route even if present in lookup resources
A number retained or changed by first-pass software still routes
Dictionary/name-list results affect word/name routing, never numeric inclusion
Amounts/dates/years/identifiers/ordinals/written/Roman numeric forms have explicit coverage tests; ambiguous or unsupported cases are recorded, never silently certified clean
Multiple numbers in one assigned target remain covered by one grouped full-target inspection; no token-by-token duplicate requests
Missing/unclear images produce queued/unavailable/withheld outcomes, not a clean exemption
scope: Clarifies desired pipeline routing, not whether every number is wrong and not permission for an unbounded live/corpus run. Original sample/limits, uncertainty, source preservation and old results remain unchanged.

validation.bounded_luna_review: No material issue; every-number requirement and honest coverage gaps confirmed.
